headline: Peru Central Reserve Bank Sets December Launch for Tapp Payment Pilot
summary: The official pilot of Tapp, the payment platform of Peru's Central Reserve Bank, will begin on December 23 following an initial friend-and-family trial involving four entities.
why: Central bank digital payments infrastructure initiatives reshape domestic financial inclusion, retail banking competition, and transaction fee structures.

impacts.name: Peru
impacts.why: New central bank digital payment systems impact domestic financial technology and banking services.
